title: Testing an npm Package Locally
description: Pack the package into a tarball, install it globally from that file, and run it, so you can test exactly what will be published.

steps.description: These commands test the package locally before publishing. The page says to pack the package into a tarball, a single compressed archive file, without uploading it, so you can inspect exactly what will be published and install it locally.
`npm pack` creates the tarball; the comment names it `yourname-mylang-0.1.0.tgz`.
`npm install -g` installs that tarball globally, and `mylang tests/hello.ml` runs the installed command on a test file.
